title: 12th South Guest House Walk to Everything!
description:
Our location one block off 12th Ave and  Belmont Blvd.  Uber ride or walkable , so close to Hillsboro and Belmont and Vanderbilt Universities, The Gulch, Green Hills, Music Row, Midtown and Downtown . You’ll love my place in the best historic neighborhood and totally walking distance to shopping, eating, park and more. Its great for couples, solo adventurers, business travelers, and families. Can't wait to have you!

The space
Private quiet retreat private parking pad for the guest house, you are less than a block to grab a bit to eat or a coffee, family friendly community in 12th south. We do ask that you not sleep on the couch, there are 2 beds for a maximum of 4 people. We appreciate your understanding!

Guest access
Park on gravel pad (to the right side of garage) enter a private entrance via a paved path taking you to the single door into garage and then into spacious retreat in our guest house upstairs over 3 car garage.
You don't even need a car

Other things to note
Easy Walking Distance:  Locust Postino, Jeni’s Splendid Ice Cream, Taproom, Embers Ski Lodge, Intown Golf Club, La La Land Kind Cafe, Todd Snyder, Rancher Hat Bar, Kendra Scott, Sushi-San, SunLife Organics, Jo Malone, Burdlife, Vince, Lululemon, and Roark, Buttermilk Ranch, Bottle Cap, Frothy Monkey, Urban Grub, Edley’s Barbecue, Lady Bird Taco, The Henry, Bar Taco, White Bison Coffee, Mesero 12th South, Burger Up, Epice, and MANY MORE!!
Short Drive, Scooter Ride, or Longer Walk: Belmont & Lipscomb Universities, Sevier Park, Martin’s BBQ, Bi-Rite Grocery, Proper Bagel, International Market, 615 Deli, Zanie’s Comedy Club, 8th and Roast, Love Peace and Pho, The Cookery
Less than 2 miles: Vanderbilt University, The Gulch – numerous hotels, restaurants, shops, bars, work out studios, clubs, etc. 
Less than 3 miles: Bridgestone Arena, Ryman Auditorium, Schermerhorn Symphony Center, Ascend Amphitheatre, Music City Center, BROADWAY and the rest of fabulous downtown Nashville!
Others Within 5 miles: Nissan Stadium, Top Golf, Musicians Hall of Fame, Green Hills Mall and entire Green Hills District
